messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"chapter":2,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":2,"verse":1,"text":"The Lord says, “I brought this people out of bondage. I gave them my commandments by my servants the prophets, whom they would not listen to, but made my counsels void."},{"chapter":2,"verse":2,"text":"The mother who bore them says to them, ‘Go your way, my children, for I am a widow and forsaken."},{"chapter":2,"verse":3,"text":"I brought you up with gladness, and I have lost you with sorrow and heaviness, for you have sinned before the Lord God, and done that which is evil before me."},{"chapter":2,"verse":4,"text":"But now what can I do for you? For I am a widow and forsaken. Go your way, my children, and ask for mercy from the Lord.’"},{"chapter":2,"verse":5,"text":"As for me, O father, I call upon you for a witness in addition to the mother of these children, because they would not keep my covenant,"},{"chapter":2,"verse":6,"text":"that you may bring them to confusion, and their mother to ruin, that they may have no offspring."},{"chapter":2,"verse":7,"text":"Let them be scattered abroad among the heathen. Let their names be blotted out of the earth, for they have despised my covenant."},{"chapter":2,"verse":8,"text":"Woe to you, Assur, you who hide the unrighteous with you! You wicked nation, remember what I did to Sodom and Gomorrah,"},{"chapter":2,"verse":9,"text":"whose land lies in lumps of pitch and heaps of ashes. That is what I will also do to those who have not listened to me,” says the Lord Almighty."},{"chapter":2,"verse":10,"text":"The Lord says to Esdras, “Tell my people that I will give them the kingdom of Jerusalem, which I would have given to Israel."},{"chapter":2,"verse":11,"text":"I will also take their glory back to myself, and give these the everlasting tabernacles which I had prepared for them."},{"chapter":2,"verse":12,"text":"They will have the tree of life for fragrant perfume. They will neither labor nor be weary."},{"chapter":2,"verse":13,"text":"Ask, and you will receive. Pray that your days may be few, that they may be shortened. The kingdom is already prepared for you. Watch!"},{"chapter":2,"verse":14,"text":"Call heaven and earth to witness. Call them to witness, for I have left out evil, and created the good, for I live, says the Lord."},{"chapter":2,"verse":15,"text":"“Mother, embrace your children. I will bring them out with gladness like a dove does. Establish their feet, for I have chosen you, says the Lord."},{"chapter":2,"verse":16,"text":"I will raise those who are dead up again from their places, and bring them out from their tombs, for I recognize my name in them."},{"chapter":2,"verse":17,"text":"Don’t be afraid, you mother of children, for I have chosen you, says the Lord."},{"chapter":2,"verse":18,"text":"For your help, I will send my servants Esaias and Jeremy, after whose counsel I have sanctified and prepared for you twelve trees laden with various fruits,"},{"chapter":2,"verse":19,"text":"and as many springs flowing with milk and honey, and seven mighty mountains, on which roses and lilies grow, with which I will fill your children with joy."},{"chapter":2,"verse":20,"text":"Do right to the widow. Secure justice for the fatherless. Give to the poor. Defend the orphan. Clothe the naked."}]}
